label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is user-controlled: bar = param.replace("\"", """) where param comes from request.getParameter(), allowing attackers to inject XSS payloads (e.g., <script>, event handlers) since the replacement only escapes double quotes, not angle brackets or other dangerous constructs. The sink writes bar directly into HTML output via response.getWriter().println().

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter flows through replace() to sink expression in HTML output
